title: Content Creator
tools_required: facebook; instagram; tiktok; youtube; excel; social media
why_it_fits: Content Creator match. 6 skills: facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube, excel. Possibly PH-OK (Multi-country incl US). Contract - matches IC status
about_the_company: BetterWild is on a mission to create the most animal friendly pet brand on the planet and we’re looking for a pet-loving Content Creator to support our growth! Recently launched and just beginning to scale, this business is young and full of opportunity. This role will be our first in-house content creator and will play a key part in establishing a rock solid foundation for the future. We are a lean, agile team looking for a creative, self-motivated creator to join us.
position_overview: We're looking for a skilled video content creator!
key_responsibilities:
Develop, shoot, and edit original video content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok (this includes both short- and long-form videos, depending on the platform) 

Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and changes across the platforms, including viral content and platform updates 

Co-opt trends in a way that fits our brand and resonates with our audience, while staying true to our brand 

Work closely with our in-house creative team to keep organic and paid content in sync, as appropriate, and identify collaboration opportunities 

Edit raw footage into high-quality videos with strong, clear messaging and compelling visuals; add captions, graphics, music, etc. as appropriate

Engage with followers and reply to comments; actively court and interact with influencers and potential partners to build our presence 

Monitor and report video performance across platforms; synthesize insights for the team and use them to refine and improve both the content and the strategy
location_work_setup: Remote; United States; Multi-country incl US
application_process: Apply through gusto using the original posting URL.
